name: Accessibility and Compatibility Testing
purpose: Identify accessibility and compatibility test scenarios only when supported by the provided requirements or project documentation.

apply_when: The requirement explicitly mentions keyboard operation.
The requirement explicitly mentions screen readers.
The requirement explicitly mentions assistive technologies.
The requirement explicitly mentions WCAG or an accessibility standard.
The requirement explicitly specifies supported browsers.
The requirement explicitly specifies supported devices.
The requirement explicitly specifies responsive behavior.
The requirement explicitly specifies operating-system compatibility.
do_not_apply_when: Accessibility is not mentioned or reasonably supported by the supplied requirements.
A compliance level would have to be invented.
A browser or device would have to be invented.

coverage_dimensions.name: Keyboard Navigation
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify keyboard operation when keyboard accessibility is explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Focus Behavior
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify focus behavior when explicitly required or when the requirement specifically describes focus management.

coverage_dimensions.name: Screen Reader
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify screen-reader behavior when explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Accessible Labels
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly required labels or accessible names.

coverage_dimensions.name: Accessible Error Messages
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify accessibility of explicitly required validation or error messages.

coverage_dimensions.name: Color / Visual Accessibility
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify visual accessibility requirements when explicitly specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: WCAG Compliance
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly specified WCAG requirements or conformance levels.

coverage_dimensions.name: Responsive Layout
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify responsive behavior when responsive behavior or supported screen sizes are specified.

examples.requirement: The login form must be fully operable using the keyboard.
applicable_scenarios: Navigate through login controls using keyboard
Verify keyboard focus moves through the required controls

examples.requirement: The application supports Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.

unknown_information.rule: Missing accessibility or compatibility requirements must be reported rather than invented.
